gitCommit.subject: fix(portal): app-added stores open on approval even during the trial; previews at 600/800
gitCommit.body:
fix(portal): app-added stores open on approval even during the trial; previews at 600/800

The pay window for a store added in the app says it opens as soon as its payment is
confirmed, even while the free trial runs (0132). The D176 note now applies only to
stores and seats requested on the portal page. The preview fixture's new-store prices
match production (600 / 300 / 800 MRU).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
